title: Curriculum Night at OSHS
summary: Presenting our robot and robotics program to parents and students at our school.
author: Nathan L
body: In collaboration with FRC team 4013 Clockwork Mania and FTC teams 17288 Rubber Bandits and 20344 Cattlebots, we showcased our robotics program to around 100 people that attended our school's (Orlando Science High School) curriculum night.

body.caption: Around a hundred people came through over the evening.
Last season's banners hung behind the demo area.

body: Our demo included driving and shooting the worlds robot from last year and explaining the role our team plays in the greater community.
